lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately six semi-parallel horizontal rows of high-intensity circular pixel clusters extending from the posterior gill margin toward the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a distinct rectilinear grid pattern on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal ridges visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high intensity on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Discrete high-luminance blobs scattered across the first dorsal fin surface, with approximately 10-12 spots visible within the fin's macro-mask.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, circular, dark-brownish lesion or ectoparasite attachment is visible on the anterior-lateral region, posterior to the eye.
other_distinctive_markers: A complex, non-circular vermiculated pattern of high-luminance pixels located on the dorsal-lateral surface immediately above the gill slits.
